family_decision.reason: The five direct company-named repositories are prototype mechanisms without positive test/runtime receipts. The audit also found unsupported outcome claims and concrete implementation or verification defects.

shared_findings.finding: Four repositories use the identical CI workflow blob 4e55a776a8a4926708530125b00ecc38f5a7a0c8, which triggers on main/develop while each audited repository defaults to master. Default-branch changes therefore lack the intended CI coverage.
shared_findings.promotion_gate: CI must execute on the actual default branch and produce a positive receipt.

shared_findings.finding: No audited repository currently provides evidence sufficient to support production-effectiveness, comparative-performance, or failure-prediction claims.
shared_findings.promotion_gate: Replace unsupported outcome language with bounded mechanism claims or attach reproducible benchmark/runtime receipts.

repositories.observed_mechanism: Confidence-weighted aggregation of same-named metrics across infrastructure layers plus a simple aggregate health score.
defects_or_claim_gaps: Stored timestamps are not used to reject or down-weight stale layer observations.
A same-named metric with contributors whose confidence weights sum to zero can divide by zero.
The current example mostly uses disjoint metrics, so the claimed fusion behavior is only lightly demonstrated.
No deterministic test or runtime benchmark receipt was observed.

repositories.observed_mechanism: Current-state candidate filtering and weighted scoring across cost, latency, GPU availability, and provider preference.
defects_or_claim_gaps: The implementation is not a time-expanded graph router and does not pre-compute future resource windows as claimed in the module documentation.
The claimed 15-25 percent utilization improvement over greedy scheduling has no observed benchmark receipt.
The executable example calls random.uniform before importing random and therefore fails before routing.
The checked-in CI workflow does not trigger on the repository default branch master.
required_next_evidence: actual temporal-planning implementation or removal of that claim
comparative benchmark before any utilization claim

repositories.observed_mechanism: Per-GPU closed/open/half-open circuit-breaker state with a failure threshold and timeout-based recovery probe.
defects_or_claim_gaps: can_execute mutates breaker state, so status inspection can change state.
evaluate_gpu calls can_execute more than once per evaluation.
The example records only one failure on the failing GPU and therefore does not demonstrate the default three-failure isolation threshold.
No deterministic test receipt was observed.
The checked-in CI workflow does not trigger on the repository default branch master.
required_next_evidence: timeout recovery tests using an injectable clock

repositories.observed_mechanism: Behavioral metric baselines, z-score anomaly detection, and windowed trend comparison.
defects_or_claim_gaps: ingest updates the baseline with the current reading before evaluating that reading, contaminating the reference distribution and potentially reducing anomaly sensitivity.
Alert callback exceptions are swallowed without an observable failure record.
No CI workflow was present in the audited root tree.
No benchmark was observed for claims that the mechanism detects degradation before user impact or catches failures threshold monitoring misses.
required_next_evidence: comparative detection benchmark before outcome claims

repositories.observed_mechanism: Binned Shannon entropy over metric windows, averaged system entropy, and a heuristic entropy-trend warning path.
defects_or_claim_gaps: The source claims no one has built this, which is not established by repository evidence.
The demo never calls update_baselines, so its per-metric entropy anomaly path is not demonstrated against a learned baseline.
The failure prediction time horizon is a heuristic formula rather than an empirically calibrated estimate.
Claims about predicting failure before metric alarms and saving downtime have no observed runtime or benchmark receipt.
The checked-in CI workflow does not trigger on the repository default branch master.
required_next_evidence: calibration dataset and evaluation protocol before prediction claims
